facts.headline: Exclusive - Broadcom to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion to lease its chips , filing says
facts.note: Vendor financing: Broadcom lends so Anthropic can lease Broadcom chips, a circular flow. Three outlets carry it; the story cites a filing (Anthropic IPO prospectus). Confirm there and upgrade.

facts.headline: SoftBank completes final phase of $30 billion investment in OpenAI
facts.note: Supports the seed amount of $30bn (invested) over the $40bn some sources cited. Three outlets carry it.

facts.headline: Anthropic Plans to Spend $518 Billion on Cloud and Data Centers . More Than $100 Billion Is Already Promised to Amazon .
facts.note: Coverage of the IPO prospectus corroborates the $100bn+ AWS commitment already on the edge.
